about_short_description.short_description: Metofico provides a no-code analysis platform for life science research.

product.name: Fibre Photometry Analyser
product.description: A tool for importing and processing large data sets with up to 4 light channels, featuring digital filtering, event management, normalization pipelines, and built-in plotting for data exploration.

product.name: AI-Based Rodent Tracker
product.description: A system for live and offline rodent segmentation, custom behavior scoring, and automated generalization, providing key metrics such as velocity, direction, and ROI statistics.

product.name: Advanced Feeding Patterns
product.description: An analysis tool for meal patterns using weighted hoppers or pellets and lick microstructure analysis, offering more than 15 variables to explore.
